sentences.back: Big trees and green parks are good for cities.
People like to walk in green spaces.
When a city has more green, people want to live there.
More people living there means houses cost more money.
This is good for real estate.
Growing food high up in buildings is a new idea.
They help people get fresh food.
This is good for food security.
It means everyone can get food.
They also help keep the air clean.
Putting money into green spaces and farms is a smart investment.
Good city planning puts trees and farms in the right places.
This makes cities better places for everyone.
